product_goal: Help an SMB leader recognize where the company is today, what it wants to achieve, and a broad set of concrete areas where potential may be underused or current systems may cover needs poorly. The experience should surface many plausible opportunities efficiently, then let the leader indicate which business sections matter most to improve. Cobreo uses those choices plus observed evidence to generate useful, specific result cards without forcing a problem.

progress.mobile: Show the active stage and a segmented progress bar. Do not compress every stage label into one row.

target.post_priority_followups: 0–2 total, only if one answer is required to make a selected result materially more useful

question_context.rule: Every conditional screen must be understandable without remembering the prior screen.
question_context.fallback: Show a persistent context chip/header such as 'À propos de : Suivi des employés'.
question_context.test: If this screen were shown alone, would the respondent know exactly what business subject is being discussed?

selection.single_select_only_for: mutually exclusive states, scales, or one primary priority

scan_budget.rule: A longer checklist is allowed only when it replaces multiple low-value screens and remains scannable on mobile.

typography.rule: Core content must never look like secondary copy. Prioritize readability over fitting more options above the fold.

rules: Use small color accents, chips, left borders or icons to create hierarchy.
Never rely on color alone; always pair it with text or an icon.
Do not use red/green as bad/good performance grades.
Do not make a low-confidence hypothesis visually stronger than a respondent-prioritized, well-supported opportunity.
Keep question screens visually calm; reserve stronger hierarchy for the prioritization and result pages.

layout_rules: Each card shows section name and 1–3 service chips by default.
Evidence is collapsed under 'Pourquoi ces services?'.
Use large readable typography and restrained service accents.

coverage_engine.principle: Breadth of relevant business coverage matters more than depth on early signals.
rules: A non-selected capability remains potentially_uncovered until another signal supports it.
Do not interrupt the breadth-first scan to confirm every potential gap.
High-value gap hypotheses may be included in a generated section card if context + ambition make them clearly relevant; the respondent's selection then acts as an interest confirmation.
If the respondent does not prioritize that section, keep the hypothesis secondary or internal unless independent evidence is strong.

deepening_policy.principle: Do not deepen simply because a signal exists. First scan broadly and let the respondent prioritize. Deepen only selected sections when one missing answer is essential to produce a useful result.
deepening_policy.default_selected_section_behavior: Use existing evidence to produce the result without another question when possible.
allowed_question_types: missing_capability_confirmation_if_a_prioritized_section_is based primarily on a non-selection hypothesis
deepening_policy.quantification_exception: Only use a structural quantity if the result would be materially misleading without it. This should be rare and never triggered automatically from a selected task.
question_value_gate: Can we already write a specific, useful result from existing answers?
Would this answer change the opportunity direction, not just make it more precise?
Would the respondent reasonably understand why we are asking it?
deepening_policy.contextual_copy_rule: Every conditional question names the business activity/topic on the same screen.

educational_layer.purpose: Help the respondent understand why an uncovered capability can matter without pretending it is a proven problem.
rules: Use short conceptual explanations by default.
Do not use unsupported statistics.
Any numeric external fact must have a verifiable stored source before production.
Educational content must not be used to pressure the respondent into selecting an answer.

rules: Only medium/high-confidence candidates may appear as main prospect opportunities.

simulation_rounds.main_change: Replace micro-friction qualification with company context, ambitions and 9 capability areas.
failures_found: Scanning all nine areas deeply is too long for small/simple companies.
Non-selected capabilities were initially over-interpreted as gaps.
Some area labels were too internal/consulting-like.
red_team_rejections: Mandatory full scan of all nine areas.
Treat every unselected capability as an opportunity.
Show Cobreo service lenses before understanding the company.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Use applicability + high-value one-screen scans; non-selection creates only a hypothesis.
simulation_rounds.scorecard_note: Qualitative comparative estimate from simulated personas; not empirical user data.

simulation_rounds.focus: Relevant omission analysis and dynamic applicability.
simulation_rounds.main_change: Coverage states and max two gap confirmations based on context + ambition.
failures_found: A few omission confirmations felt leading when ambition alignment was weak.
Team/finance lists became dense on mobile.
red_team_rejections: Ask the respondent to explain every non-selected capability.
Score coverage numerically for the prospect.
Force a missing capability to become a problem.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Confirm only candidates that could change top opportunities; keep coverage internal.
simulation_rounds.scorecard_note: Qualitative comparative estimate from simulated personas; not empirical user data.

simulation_rounds.focus: Cobreo potential lenses and result value.
simulation_rounds.main_change: Map capabilities to six value-oriented Cobreo lenses and redesign results around ambition + potential map + evidence cards.
failures_found: Tailored-tools lens could look like a sales pitch.
Too many service examples made cards feel prescriptive.
Educational content can become leading if shown before answers.
red_team_rejections: Show all six lenses with scores.
Recommend a custom app from poor tool satisfaction alone.
Use unsourced industry statistics to make opportunities sound stronger.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Show only supported lenses; tailored tools needs strongest guardrail; educational notes after discovery/results.
simulation_rounds.scorecard_note: Qualitative comparative estimate from simulated personas; not empirical user data.

simulation_rounds.main_change: Question-value gate; remove generic irritation/effort measures; retain frequency/fit/desire only when analytically discriminating.
failures_found: Without any quantification, rare automation tasks could rank too high.
Some healthy-but-optimizable areas needed one explicit interest signal.
red_team_rejections: Remove all frequency/volume questions.
Ask frequency and effort for every candidate.
Use 1–10 pain scales.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Selective frequency/volume + fit + improvement desire only; no generic pain score.
simulation_rounds.scorecard_note: Qualitative comparative estimate from simulated personas; not empirical user data.

simulation_rounds.main_change: Run 24 persona reference cases; tighten context independence, healthy outcomes, emerging needs, off-priority discovery and coverage gate.
failures_found: No new structural failure repeated across multiple personas; remaining concerns are wording density and real-user interpretation.
Some sectors will need better examples after real pilot data.
red_team_rejections: Add more scans to improve theoretical coverage.
Force at least one opportunity for every company.
Use sector alone to infer a capability need.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Stop simulated structural iteration. V7.4 is ready for limited real-prospect testing; next changes require observed user behavior.
simulation_rounds.scorecard_note: Qualitative comparative estimate from simulated personas; not empirical user data.

simulation_rounds.main_change: Stop deepening each signal; accumulate signals across business sections first.
failures_found: If every signal becomes its own priority card, the prioritization screen is too long.
Some direct opportunity checklists sounded too problem-seeking when every option described a weakness.
red_team_rejections: One card per micro-opportunity.
Ask frequency or effort to rank every manual task.
Turn every unselected capability into a surfaced gap.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Cluster signals by business section and mix coverage scans with opportunity-signal scans.

simulation_rounds.main_change: Generated section cards summarize detected signals; respondent chooses up to three sections to improve.
failures_found: A pure respondent-choice model could hide one strong opportunity the respondent did not prioritize.
Weak omission hypotheses could look authoritative when placed on a polished card.
red_team_rejections: Only show opportunities from sections the respondent selected.
Show section cards supported by one weak non-selection.
Use a numeric opportunity score to make cards look objective.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Prioritized sections lead results, but allow one strong unprioritized secondary potential. Require evidence for every card.

simulation_rounds.main_change: Remove generic frequency, effort, irritation and desire scales; combine manual-task gate + list into one checklist.
failures_found: Without any guardrail, a trivial manual item could look equivalent to a broader strategic gap.
Some result directions still needed current-solution fit, but only after prioritization.
red_team_rejections: Bring frequency back as a standard automation qualifier.
Use pain score to rank candidate sections.
Add a generic 'how important is this' scale after prioritization.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Use evidence multiplicity + ambitions + respondent section choice; reserve at most two post-priority questions for direction-changing unknowns.

simulation_rounds.main_change: Context-safe screens, larger typography, visual priority/result hierarchy, expanded adversarial cases, instrumentation for real tests.
failures_found: No repeated structural failure in simulated reference cases after the breadth/prioritization shift.
Remaining uncertainty is behavioral: list scanning, wording interpretation, whether generated section cards feel accurate, and real completion burden.
red_team_rejections: Add another universal scan to maximize theoretical coverage.
Force one follow-up for every selected priority section.
Use stronger problem wording to improve lead conversion.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Stop simulated structural iteration and move to limited real-user testing. Further structural additions now risk reducing simplicity without evidence.

simulation_rounds.main_change: Collapse ambitions into one multi-select; remove repeated potential taxonomy from prospect page; require concrete opportunity cards and explicit Cobreo solution bridge.
failures_found: V7.8 could repeat the same information as priority sections, Cobreo potential blocks and generic suggestion cards.
Generic fallback titles could expose internal capability labels or produce circular reasoning.
Repeated 'Potentiel important' created false certainty and weak differentiation.
red_team_rejections: Keep a standalone six-lens potential dashboard before opportunity cards: rejected as repetitive.
Use respondent-selected section as an opportunity title: rejected because a category is not an opportunity.
Make every selected priority automatically 'important': rejected as circular.
Push direct software solutions in results: rejected because solution fit has not necessarily been established.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Make concrete opportunities the center of results; be direct about value and Cobreo's ability to explore solutions, while keeping solution choice open.

simulation_rounds.focus: Reduce early cognitive cost and remove low-value sector classification.
simulation_rounds.main_change: Delete the prospect-facing sector-family question; keep sector only as optional internal enrichment. Clean legacy ambition branching.
simulation_rounds.failure_observed: The first question required respondents to classify themselves among broad overlapping categories such as professional services, despite sector adding limited value to the current discovery engine.
red_team_rejections: Keep the sector question but shorten the list: rejected because the underlying information is still not valuable enough early.
Replace sector with a free-text industry field: rejected because it still spends respondent effort on information Cobreo can often obtain later.
Infer opportunities from researched industry: rejected because sector context cannot replace observed company reality.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Remove sector from the prospect journey. Reintroduce only if real pilot evidence proves it materially improves discovery or applicability.
simulation_rounds.scorecard_note: Qualitative comparative estimate only; not empirical.

simulation_rounds.focus: Very simple service-oriented results and direct booking.
simulation_rounds.main_change: Section -> relevant Cobreo services, then reserve a 15-minute call with calendar invitation.
red_team_rejections: Show every service for every selected section.
Always show custom tools.
Show website optimization from sales ambition alone.
Confirm booking before calendar event creation.
simulation_rounds.product_lead_decision: Keep the page commercially direct but evidence-grounded; let booking be the natural close.

real_prospect_pilot.recommended_phase: limited real test before broader prospect send
target_mix: at least 6 distinct sectors, including at least 2 outside professional services
real_prospect_pilot.recommended_minimum_sessions: 20–24 qualitative completions before treating patterns as stable; this is a research target, not a statistical guarantee.
real_prospect_pilot.moderation: Prefer silent completion first. Ask questions only after results so a moderator does not rescue unclear wording.
observe: hesitation and scrolling on long checklists
whether respondents understand they can select multiple answers
whether a selected signal feels like their reality
whether generated priority cards accurately summarize what they meant
whether a card built partly from a non-selection feels invented
whether respondent prioritization feels useful rather than repetitive
whether they want to change a priority after seeing the result
result card reading order and visual hierarchy
whether result wording produces a genuine realization

success_gate: No recurring critical failure across participants.
Generated priority cards are usually recognized as faithful summaries of the respondent's answers.
No repeated complaint that the questionnaire over-analyzes one small issue.
No repeated complaint that followup questions add little value.
Respondents can identify what they most want to improve from the generated section cards.
At least some participants report a useful or unexpected realization; actual rate must be measured from the pilot.
Results are specific enough that participants reject the idea they could belong to any random company.
pilot_stop_conditions: Two or more participants independently report the same priority card is invented from non-selection.
The same high-value business opportunity is missed in multiple relevant participants.
The prioritization screen is repeatedly misunderstood.
A recurring question is identified as unnecessary by both observation and interview.
Results repeatedly overstate certainty or push a Cobreo service not supported by the answers.

area_sequencing.principle: Ambitions determine where to start, never where to stop. Discovery should cover several relevant parts of the business before prioritization.
rules: Filter hard non-applicable sections first.
Start with ambition-aligned applicable sections.
Include at least one cross-cutting section outside the primary ambition when possible.
Prefer one high-yield checklist over two gate/detail screens.
Do not stop discovery because the first section looks healthy.
Do not deepen early signals during the broad scan.
Move to prioritization after enough distinct relevant sections have been explored or the signal inventory is already rich.
If almost no signals emerge and coverage is narrow, open one additional high-value section rather than asking micro-qualification questions.

question_value_audit.question: sector_family
question_value_audit.reason: High cognitive cost and ambiguous classification; current V7 branching does not need it enough to justify asking. Sector can be enriched internally later.

question_value_audit.question: company_stage
question_value_audit.decision_changed: Distinguishes emerging, active and established realities.

question_value_audit.question: company_size
question_value_audit.decision_changed: Controls team applicability and structural opportunities.

question_value_audit.question: work_models
question_value_audit.decision_changed: Adapts operations and allows coexisting work modes.

question_value_audit.question: declared_ambitions
question_value_audit.decision_changed: Multi-select max 3. High-value intent signal used to order discovery and interpret results.

question_value_audit.question: section_scans
question_value_audit.decision_changed: High-yield breadth: one screen can create multiple explicit signals and coverage hypotheses.

question_value_audit.question: manual_task_yes_no_then_task_list
question_value_audit.reason: Gate question adds little value. Replaced by one direct multi-select simplification scan.

question_value_audit.question: generic_frequency_after_manual_task
question_value_audit.reason: Does not usually change the type or usefulness of the opportunity; no longer part of normal flow.

question_value_audit.question: generic_effort_after_manual_task
question_value_audit.reason: Adds precision to pain rather than discovering new business potential.

question_value_audit.question: generic_irritation_1_to_4
question_value_audit.reason: Low information value for Cobreo opportunity discovery.

question_value_audit.question: generic_desire_to_improve_scale
question_value_audit.reason: Replaced by respondent prioritization of surfaced business sections.

question_value_audit.question: respondent_section_prioritization
question_value_audit.decision_changed: Directly identifies which surfaced parts of the business the leader believes matter most to improve.

question_value_audit.question: post_priority_followup
question_value_audit.decision_changed: Ask only when the answer changes the direction of a selected result, not merely its precision.

implementation_notes: Build V7 as a new flow rather than layering it on top of V6 stage/intensity scoring.
Do not port the old weighted stage score or friction bands.
Persist capabilities and coverage states independently from opportunity lenses.
A checked capability means it is present/covered, not necessarily satisfactory.
An unchecked capability means potentially_uncovered at most.
Run fit checks only when a current solution/process materially relates to an ambition or candidate.
Use primary ambition throughout result generation as relevance context, never as evidence by itself.
Do not render all area scans; follow area_sequencing.
Question followups must be self-contained or show a context header on the same screen.
Use multi-select whenever answers can coexist.
Do not add generic 1–4 irritation or effort scales.
Frequency/volume questions are conditional and must name the activity explicitly.
Results show supported opportunity lenses only; never render six empty/scored categories.
Tailored tools/custom software is the most guarded lens.
Educational numeric facts require stored verifiable sources before use; conceptual explanations are allowed without invented statistics.
Lead capture remains optional and visually separate from the diagnostic result.
V7.8 is breadth-first: do not deepen a selected signal during the discovery scan by default.
Replace automation yes/no + task list with one direct multi-select simplification checklist.
Do not implement generic frequency, effort, irritation or pain scales in the normal flow.
After 4–6 relevant scans, generate business-section cards from the respondent's own signals and high-value contextual coverage hypotheses.
Ask the respondent to choose up to three business sections they most want to improve or explore.
Use those choices as a major relevance signal for results.
Allow one strong unprioritized opportunity to survive as a secondary potential.
Post-priority deepening is optional and capped at two total questions.
Question screens must remain self-contained and use larger mobile typography.
Prioritization and result pages should use restrained semantic color accents and stronger visual hierarchy.
Do not render a second ambitions question.
Remove sector_family from all prospect-visible screens and required state.
The first prospect question is company_stage.
Sector may exist only as optional internal_context.sector_hint enriched after or outside the questionnaire.
All ambition branching must use membership checks against declared_ambitions[].
Do not reintroduce a sector dropdown unless real pilot evidence shows a concrete discovery/branching benefit that cannot be obtained more simply.
Replace current long prospect result cards with simple business-section -> service cards.
Keep 'Pourquoi ces services?' collapsed by default.
Do not render generic potential scores.
Make direct 15-minute calendar booking the primary close.
Create the calendar event and add the prospect as attendee before showing booking confirmation.

schema_checks: Every multi-select has explicit instruction copy.
Exclusive none/not-applicable options cannot coexist with substantive options.
Every conditional followup includes an explicit same-screen referent.
No normal-flow question id contains generic_frequency, generic_effort, irritation or pain_score.
Priority cards must be generated from traceable signals.
No priority card can be generated from ambition alone or one weak non-selection.
Result opportunity cards must cite their supporting answer ids internally.
No result card may recommend custom software directly from tool count or manual work.
declared_ambitions is a multi-select with max 3 and no secondary ambitions screen.
No visible result title may equal a business-section label.
No visible result copy may contain internal ids or untranslated English capability names.
No prospect result page renders a standalone potential-lens block that duplicates concrete opportunities.
No visible generic importance grade is required.
Every primary result card has traceable evidence and a concrete action/outcome title.
The Cobreo solution bridge comes after analytical value and does not prescribe custom software.
sector_family does not exist in company_context prospect questions.
company_stage is the first prospect-visible company-context question.
sector_hint is optional internal context only.
No opportunity may be created from sector_hint alone.
No branch condition uses legacy primary_ambition; use membership in declared_ambitions[].
manual_copy_review: Avoid judgmental 'encore/toujours/trop/inutilement/devrait' unless strictly descriptive and necessary.
Check every option for mobile length and reading level.

section_model.purpose: These are concrete parts of the business that the respondent can recognize. They are not Cobreo service categories.
section_model.rule: A section can generate multiple Cobreo potential lenses. The respondent prioritizes business sections, not service products.

breadth_first_discovery.principle: During discovery, prefer breadth to depth. Store a useful signal and move to another relevant part of the business.
do_not_do: Do not ask frequency simply because a repetitive task was selected.
Do not ask effort simply because a manual task was selected.
Do not ask irritation or pain scales.
Do not immediately investigate every selected item.
Do not require the respondent to explain why every non-selected capability is missing.
signal_sources: existing system fit when already known
breadth_first_discovery.default_behavior_after_signal: Store the signal, map it to candidate business sections and Cobreo potentials, then continue scanning.
breadth_first_discovery.when_to_interrupt_breadth: Only when an answer is required immediately to prevent a clearly irrelevant branch or unsafe inference.

candidate_inventory.purpose: Accumulate many plausible opportunities before asking the respondent what deserves attention.

sources.explicit_signal: A selected situation directly suggests an improvement possibility.
sources.coverage_gap_hypothesis: A relevant capability was not selected. This is a hypothesis only.
sources.cross_signal: Two or more answers combine into a higher-value possibility, e.g. hours tracked + profitability ambition + no labor-cost visibility.
sources.ambition: Raises relevance but never creates a candidate alone.
sources.tools: Context only unless paired with a need/fit signal.

rules: Non-selection is never treated as proof of absence.
Do not show every candidate to the respondent.
Prefer candidates supported by explicit selection, cross-signal logic, or strong context + ambition relevance.
A candidate can be stored without asking another question.
Do not calculate pain or annoyance scores.
Do not use tool count as an opportunity score.

respondent_prioritization.principle: Let the leader tell us which of the surfaced business sections are most worthwhile to improve. This replaces most micro-qualification.

screen.title_fr: Ce qui pourrait valoir la peine d’être amélioré
screen.intro_fr: À partir de vos réponses, voici les endroits où il semble y avoir le plus de potentiel. Lesquels seraient les plus intéressants à améliorer ou à explorer dans les prochains mois?

fallback_option.label_fr: Aucun de ces sujets n’est une priorité pour le moment

signals_fr: Certaines informations sont saisies plus d’une fois
Des façons de faire importantes sont peu documentées
card_example.potential_fr: Possibilité de simplifier la circulation de l’information et de mieux conserver les façons de faire.

ranking_for_cards: confirmed or very context-relevant coverage-gap hypothesis
rules: Ambition alignment breaks ties; it does not manufacture evidence.
Do not show a section card with only a weak non-selection.
When many signals exist, cluster them by business section rather than showing one card per micro-opportunity.
Selecting a section is a strong respondent-interest signal and replaces generic desire-to-improve scales.
An unselected but strongly supported opportunity may still appear later as one secondary potential, clearly separated from respondent priorities.

v78_simulation_summary.panel_note: Qualitative simulated persona panel, not empirical users.
v78_simulation_summary.qualitative_result: No repeated structural failure found after breadth-first + section-prioritization redesign. Main remaining risks are real-user list scanning, wording interpretation, and whether generated section summaries feel accurate.
v78_simulation_summary.scorecard_note: Comparative qualitative estimate only; not measured user data.

result_opportunity_templates.principle: Translate signals into concrete business opportunities before rendering. Business sections and Cobreo lenses are metadata, not the recommendation itself.

team_hours.title_fr: Mieux exploiter les heures déjà enregistrées
team_hours.what_we_see_fr: Vous suivez déjà les heures travaillées de votre équipe.
team_hours.what_could_improve_fr: Selon les autres informations disponibles, ces heures pourraient servir à mieux comprendre la charge de travail, les coûts ou la performance des travaux.
team_hours.what_it_could_bring_fr: Une vue plus utile de la façon dont le temps est investi et, lorsque les données le permettent, de la rentabilité ou de la capacité de l’équipe.
team_hours.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Regarder comment mieux utiliser les données déjà disponibles, sans présumer qu’il faut changer vos outils actuels.
team_hours.guardrail: Do not state that hours are currently underused unless another answer supports that fact.

documentation_gap.title_fr: Rendre les façons de faire importantes plus faciles à transmettre
documentation_gap.what_we_see_fr: Vous avez indiqué que certaines façons de faire importantes sont peu documentées.
documentation_gap.what_could_improve_fr: Structurer les connaissances qui valent réellement la peine d’être conservées et les rendre plus faciles à retrouver.
documentation_gap.what_it_could_bring_fr: Plus de continuité dans le travail, une transmission plus simple et moins de dépendance à l’information gardée en tête.
documentation_gap.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Identifier ce qui mérite d’être documenté et choisir une façon simple de rendre cette information accessible au bon moment.

work_visibility.title_fr: Voir plus clairement où en sont les travaux
work_visibility.what_we_see_fr: Vous avez indiqué qu’il n’est pas toujours simple de voir où en sont les dossiers, travaux ou commandes.
work_visibility.what_could_improve_fr: Rendre l’état des travaux, les prochaines étapes et les éléments qui demandent de l’attention plus visibles.
work_visibility.what_it_could_bring_fr: Des priorités plus claires, des suivis plus simples et une meilleure coordination du travail.
work_visibility.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Regarder comment donner une vue utile de l’avancement sans ajouter inutilement de gestion.

information_reentry.title_fr: Éviter de recopier la même information
information_reentry.what_we_see_fr: Vous avez indiqué que certaines informations sont recopiées ou saisies plus d’une fois.
information_reentry.what_could_improve_fr: Réutiliser plus directement l’information déjà disponible entre les étapes ou les outils concernés.
information_reentry.what_it_could_bring_fr: Moins de manipulations, moins de risques d’écart entre les versions et un travail plus fluide.
information_reentry.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Identifier où l’information est reprise et regarder la façon la plus simple de réduire ces doubles manipulations.

customer_feedback_gap.title_fr: Mieux utiliser les retours clients pour décider quoi améliorer
customer_feedback_gap.what_we_see_rule: Only render a factual statement after explicit confirmation or a supporting cross-signal; otherwise phrase as a possibility.
customer_feedback_gap.what_could_improve_fr: Faire remonter plus clairement ce que les clients apprécient, demandent ou rencontrent afin d’orienter les améliorations.
customer_feedback_gap.what_it_could_bring_fr: Une meilleure lecture de l’expérience client et des signaux utiles pour faire évoluer l’offre ou le service.
customer_feedback_gap.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Regarder quels retours valent la peine d’être recueillis et comment les rendre réellement utiles à la prise de décision.

profitability_visibility.title_fr: Mieux comprendre ce qui contribue réellement à la rentabilité
profitability_visibility.what_we_see_rule: Use only confirmed finance/team answers. Do not assume profitability is unavailable from one non-selection.
profitability_visibility.what_could_improve_fr: Relier les informations déjà disponibles sur le travail, les coûts ou les revenus pour obtenir une vue plus utile de la rentabilité.
profitability_visibility.what_it_could_bring_fr: Des décisions plus éclairées sur les prix, les types de travaux, les ressources et les priorités.
profitability_visibility.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Regarder quelles données sont déjà disponibles et quelle vue de rentabilité serait réellement utile au dirigeant.

fallback_generation_rules: Never generate a fallback title from the section label.
A fallback opportunity must contain one explicit business activity + one improvement direction.
If the engine cannot write a concrete title from supported evidence, do not render a main opportunity card; keep the signal internal or ask one decision-changing followup.

company_context_policy.first_question_fr: Où en êtes-vous avec votre entreprise aujourd’hui?
rules: Do not ask the respondent to classify their sector or industry.
Only collect context that changes applicability, sequencing, wording or opportunity interpretation.
Context that can be researched or confirmed later should not consume early questionnaire attention.
If company_size indicates one person, automatically suppress team-only questions.
Use customer_types and work_models only because they directly help adapt relevant discovery sections.

forbidden_use: make a prospect answer a sector-classification question

internal_context_enrichment.rule: Missing enrichment must never block questionnaire completion or result generation.

services.label_fr: Information et aide à la décision
Présence en ligne et optimisation du site

rules: Show only services supported by respondent answers.
custom_tool requires an important fit gap or business-specific unmet need.
online_presence requires a client-facing or sales-path signal, not sales ambition alone.
automation requires a repetitive/manual/follow-up/transfer/generation signal.
information_decision requires an information/visibility/reporting/decision signal.
Show 1–3 supported services per section; maximum 4.
Do not show a section solely because it was selected earlier.
Do not show generic opportunity grades.
Do not expose internal lens ids.

customer_experience: client/prospect journey, feedback, request, onboarding or service signal
online_presence: offer presentation, online discovery, website fit, inquiry/conversion signal
custom_tool: important need + current-solution fit gap or specific workflow poorly covered

rules: Section prioritization raises relevance but is not enough by itself.
Do not show custom_tool because spreadsheets or several tools are used.
Do not show online_presence because sales growth was selected as an ambition.
If evidence is weak, omit the service.

booking.title_fr: Vous voulez regarder les solutions ensemble?
booking.body_fr: Réservez 15 minutes avec Cobreo pour reprendre les sections qui vous intéressent et voir quelles solutions seraient les plus pertinentes.
flow: collect name and email; company optional

calendar_event.description_template_fr: Échange de 15 minutes pour reprendre les opportunités identifiées et regarder les solutions possibles.
calendar_event.privacy_rule: Do not include sensitive free-text answers.

rules: Display visitor timezone clearly.
Only show slots from the connected live Cobreo calendar.
Prevent double booking.
Booking is confirmed only after successful calendar event creation.
Prospect must be added as an attendee so the calendar invitation is sent.

confirmation.body_template_fr: Votre échange de 15 minutes est prévu le {date} à {time} ({timezone}). Une invitation calendrier a été envoyée à {email}.
